PROBE = {'id': 'model-probe1', 'target': 'Textualize/rich#4147', 'about': 'ReprHighlighter tag matching', 'claims': [], 'timeout_s': 60, 'generator': 'model (nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, live)'}

import json  # added by the harness: the observations line is printed as JSON
import json
from rich.highlighter import ReprHighlighter

def get_spans(s):
    h = ReprHighlighter()
    txt = h(s)
    return [(span.start, span.end) for span in txt.spans]

inputs = {
    'adjacent': '<a>content1</a><b>content2</b>',
    'single': '<a>foo</a>',
    'nonadj_space': '<a>foo</a> <b>bar</b>',
    'nonadj_text': '<a>foo</a>xxx<b>bar</b>'
}
obs = {}
for name, inp in inputs.items():
    spans = get_spans(inp)
    obs[f"c1.{name}_span_count"] = len(spans)
    obs[f"c2.{name}_span_count"] = len(spans)
    obs[f"c3.{name}_span_count"] = len(spans)
    obs[f"c1.{name}_spans"] = spans
    obs[f"c2.{name}_spans"] = spans
    obs[f"c3.{name}_spans"] = spans

print(json.dumps({"observations": obs}))
